description: A long-standing BNI Taplus Bisnis account holder, a certified halal food export company based in Makassar, initiated a single outbound RTGS transfer of IDR 2,750,000,000 to a correspondent account at Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) for the purpose of purchasing a shipment of cacao derivatives destined for the Middle East. The transaction triggered an automated alert due to the amount exceeding the account's 90-day average single transaction value by 340%. Upon investigation by the compliance team, the transfer was found to be fully legitimate: supporting documentation included a valid export LC (Letter of Credit) issued by a reputable UAE bank, Bapebti export licensing, confirmed purchase orders, and a verified track record with the BSI destination account. The account holder's business had recently won a new export contract following Ramadan season demand.
